_meta.origin: Mirror of strategy_bullish_launchpad.json for gap-down days
asymmetry_notes: Bearish breakdowns tend to be faster/sharper than bullish breakouts on Indian indices — slightly tighter 10:15 entry window.
VIX typically SPIKES on gap-down days; VIX-level gate is more permissive here (25 vs 22) because some VIX expansion is expected and confirms the regime.
PE options have higher IV crush risk on intraday mean reversion — use 1-ITM PE (delta 0.55-0.65) to cushion.

pre_conditions.gap_fill_guard: price at 09:30 must still be < prev_day_close (gap not filled)
pre_conditions.dte_spread_switch: convert to 1-wide debit PUT spread if DTE <= 3

entry_logic.trigger: first 5m candle after 09:30 that closes below OR_low
entry_logic.confirmation: next 5m candle also closes below OR_low

pyramiding.lot_2_trigger: price <= entry - 0.25*ATR AND lot_1 in profit
pyramiding.lot_3_trigger: price <= entry - 0.50*ATR AND lot_2 in profit
pyramiding.on_each_add: move SL on all prior lots to breakeven of latest add

failed_breakdown_fast_exit.condition: price closes back above OR_low within 2 candles of lot_1 entry

regime_flip.condition: classifier regime flips away from TREND_DOWN_GAP
